== How does this build work ==
Spawn as many [[Ghost Snake|Ghost Snakes]] as you can and have as high damage as possible. Use [https://magicraft.fandom.com/wiki/Tracking Tracking] and [[spells]] like [[Orbit]] or [[Accelerator]] to increase the speed and duration of the Snakes.

== How to get this build fast ==

=== Method 1 ===

# Choose the Original Class and try to get Tracking in a shop or any other rare spell
# Go into a forge and combine your [[Magic Bullet|Magic Bullets]]
# Roll the Magic Bullet+ to a Ghost Snake+
# Roll, if you don't already have it, your rare spell to Tracking

=== Method 2 (only works with Tier 2 Dash Class) ===

# Try to get any common spell
# Go into a forge and roll it to Ghost Snake
# Replace the [[Lightning Dash]] with Ghost Snake
